title: Duel Tank Arena 钢铁前线
description: A top-down 1v1 tank duel in a compact steel arena. Pick from five weapons (cannon, five-pellet spread, instant laser, homing missile and proximity mine), fight across three handcrafted cover maps and win a best-of-five match. Play local two-player on one keyboard or one screen with split touch pads, or challenge three AI tiers: a patrolling rookie, a predictive veteran, and an ace that leads its shots, dodges incoming shells and uses cover. Fully procedural Canvas art and synthesized WebAudio; all ammo, armor and balance numbers are tuned through a 200-game per-tier AI self-play bench.
controls: Local two-player: P1 uses WASD to move, F to fire, 1-5 to pick a weapon, Q/E to cycle. P2 uses the arrow keys to move, J to fire, 6-0 to pick a weapon, U/O to cycle. On touch screens each player gets a separate direction pad, fire button and weapon button. In solo mode, choose Rookie, Veteran or Ace AI from the title screen. The turret auto-tracks the rival; use cover, strafing and weapon timing to win. First to three round wins takes the BO5. P pauses, M mutes, R restarts.
author: LightGame
